target_customer: Regulatory affairs teams at pharma, biotech and medical device companies, plus regulatory consultants
problem: Regulatory professionals spend large amounts of time finding what the FDA and other agencies expect across huge document sets, and general AI tools hallucinate or lack citations.
business_model: SaaS subscription from a free tier to a 400 USD per month project plan, annual professional and business plans and custom enterprise pricing
product_category: Vertical AI research agent for life sciences regulatory intelligence

founders.name: Chetan Mishra
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. Started as a research engineer and co-authored the ESM3 paper featured on a Science cover per the YC page. Education not found.

competitors.name: Veeva Vault
competitors.what: Established regulatory information management platform, named as a long term threat by a reviewer

competitors.name: IQVIA regulatory solutions
competitors.what: Large incumbent regulatory and clinical services and software

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval over millions of regulatory documents across agencies with citations is solid engineering and data work; the founder's stated edge is a retrieval engine tuned on life science data.

defensibility.rationale: A cleaned, indexed regulatory corpus and usage feedback could compound, but the source documents are public and incumbents can add similar search.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Reviewers flagged incumbents as the main long term threat. No acquisition or copycat release was found.

market_need_then: Drug approval work is document heavy and the founder cites 500,000 days of office work per drug. The company reports over 100 teams and 10,000 questions, and a profile cites six figure revenue in 2025, all unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses rhizomeai.com. Several other organizations use the word Rhizome.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, with Comprehensive, Hallucination-free and Traceable as headline claims

branding.community_and_virality: Founder spoke at life sciences events and gave a Data Innovation interview in 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear accuracy positioning, but the name is shared with many other organizations and no brand discussion was found.

outcome_analysis: Rhizome AI is an active Winter 2026 solo founder company with early paying users reported. The founder has relevant research engineering and enterprise sales experience but no stated regulatory career. Funding amounts are not verified. The main risks are a single founder, public source data and incumbents adding AI.
notes: Unverified: VCBacked lists 500K USD pre-seed announced December 2025 and Standout lists 585K USD total, both aggregators and probably the YC deal, so no round recorded. A 7M USD Base10 seed and a 2.5M USD chemistry pre-seed belong to other companies called Rhizome. Corpus size varies by source (44M documents, 2.5 TB, 123M pages). Product Hunt launch dated 2025-10-15 per search snippet. The Data Innovation page says New Jersey, YC says New York. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition.
